cd /Users/ayush/nightshift/work/repo && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys,hashlib
files=["jac/jaclang/compiler/passes/ecmascript/impl/esast_gen_pass.impl.jac",
"jac/jaclang/cli/commands/impl/project.impl.jac",
"jac/jaclang/cli/impl/manifest.impl.jac",
"jac/jaclang/cli/commands/impl/execution.impl.jac",
"jac/jaclang/compiler/passes/native/impl/primitives_native.impl.jac"]
W=8
for f in files:
    lines=[l.rstrip() for l in open(f)]
    seen={}
    dupes=[]
    for i in range(len(lines)-W):
        blk=[l.strip() for l in lines[i:i+W]]
        if sum(1 for b in blk if b)<W: continue
        key="\n".join(blk)
        if len(key)<120: continue
        if key in seen:
            dupes.append((seen[key]+1,i+1,blk[0][:70]))
        else:
            seen[key]=i
    # collapse consecutive
    out=[]
    last=None
    for a,b,t in dupes:
        if last and a==last[0]+1 and b==last[1]+1:
            last=(a,b,t); continue
        out.append((a,b,t)); last=(a,b,t)
    print("==",f,len(out))
    for a,b,t in out[:25]:
        print(f"   dup {W}-line block: L{a} == L{b} :: {t}")
EOF
